title: Customer Success Manager - Enterprise
description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

You’ll own a portfolio of Hiya’s largest enterprise customers across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for retention, renewals and expansion. As a trusted adviser to their senior leaders, you’ll prove the measurable value of Hiya Connect and grow each account over time. You’ll work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product and Hiya’s leadership team.

You’ll need fluent English and business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, as you’ll manage many of your European accounts in those languages.

What You'll Do

  • Own 20–25 strategic enterprise accounts across the UK and Europe. You’ll be accountable for gross and net revenue retention, renewals and expansion.

description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Director of EMEA Sales Operations to be the dedicated GTM Operations partner for our EMEA region. This role sits at the centre of EMEA's go-to-market motion, spanning New Logo, Growth, and Commercial/hybrid motions across a fast-growing, multi-country region.

 

You will partner directly with the VP of EMEA and the region's Account Executives, Business Development Reps, and Solutions Architects to deliver the insights, enablement, and processes that power territory design, quota allocation, pipeline and forecasting hygiene, and the region's operating cadence. Because EMEA spans many countries and time zones relative to global GTM Operations and Systems teams based in the US, this role requires someone who can operate with real autonomy, exercise judgment on what to escalate versus solve locally, and represent EMEA's specific needs (FSI and financial services-heavy Strategic accounts across UK/Ireland and DACH, multiple hybrid Commercial motions, territory splits across UK/Ireland, DACH, Nordics, and Southern Europe) back into Temporal's global GTM Operations function.

 

We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, surface insights, and scale operational work—not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today.

 

Responsibilities

title: Enterprise Account Director
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As an Enterprise Account Director, you will play a pivotal role in expanding Hawk's presence across leading financial institutions, Tier 1 banks, payment providers, and other regulated organizations throughout EMEA You will drive complex enterprise sales engagements, build trusted executive relationships, and help customers transform their financial crime operations through Hawk's AI-supported AML and fraud prevention platform.

顧客体験に関する主要KPIを設定・モニタリングし、分析結果や改善提案をレポートする  顧客の課題や既存の改善要望を整理し、根本原因の分析と優先順位付けを行う   3. 改善プロジェクトの企画・推進     CX改善ロードマップおよび実行計画を策定し、施策の進捗と成果を管理する  グローバルCXチーム、地域マネージャー、オペレーション、プロダクトなどの関係部門と連携し、改善施策を推進する  プロダクト開発、サービス企画、顧客向けコミュニケーション、トレーニングなど、関連プロジェクトとの整合性を確保する  複数のプロジェクト間の依存関係や必要なリソースを把握し、効果的な実行を支援する  Quality Analystによる品質評価・キャリブレーションのフィードバックをもとに、毎月の改善計画とマイルストーンを策定・実行する   4. 顧客フィードバック・サービス品質の向上     顧客の意見や懸念を収集・分析する仕組みを整備し、改善につなげる  Lifestyle Managerからのフィードバックも収集し、現場の課題や改善ニーズを把握する  Lifestyle Managerに対して、優れた顧客サービスを提供するための教育・トレーニングを実施する  エスカレーションされた顧客の問題やクレームについて、迅速かつ効果的な解決を推進する  顧客満足度、顧客ロイヤルティ、サービス品質の継続的な向上を目指す   5. グローバル連携・CX文化の醸成     グローバルCXチームや各地域の関係者と協働し、ベストプラクティスを共有する  顧客視点を組織全体に浸透させ、顧客体験を重視する文化の醸成を推進する  CXに関する業界動向や最新の手法、テクノロジーを把握し、改善施策に取り入れる  従来のやり方にとらわれず、新しい発想やアプローチを通じて、将来を見据えた顧客体験の向上を実現する     Requirements    応募資格・必須要件   英語およびビジネスレベルの日本語で、社内外の関係者と円滑にコミュニケーションできる方  顧客のニーズ、行動、期待を理解し、顧客視点で物事を考えられる方  データや顧客フィードバックを分析し、課題の特定と改善提案ができる方  顧客満足度やサービス品質の向上に向けて、主体的に課題解決に取り組める方  複数の部門や関係者と連携し、プロジェクトを推進できる方  顧客の感情や懸念を理解し、共感を持って対応できる方  顧客ニーズや事業上の優先順位の変化に柔軟に対応できる方  CSAT、NPS、CES、CLVなどの顧客満足度・ロイヤルティ指標に関する知識、または学習意欲がある方  新しいテクノロジーやデジタルツールを積極的に活用できる方   歓迎する経験・スキル   顧客体験（CX）、顧客満足度向上、カスタマーサポート、カスタマーサクセス、サービスオペレーション、品質管理（QA）などの関連業務

title: Head of Growth Europa (m/w/d)
description:
10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler, und die Parfum-Abfüllungen und Proben von 10ML in 3 ml, 10 ml und 30 ml sind ein einfacher Weg, Designer- und Nischendüfte zu entdecken. Als Head of Growth verantwortest du die gesamte Wachstumsmaschine in Europa: Akquise, Conversion, Kundenbindung und Expansion in neue Länder und Kanäle.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Wachstumsstrategie und ihre Kennzahlen: Neukunden, Conversion Rate, durchschnittlicher Bestellwert, Wiederkaufrate und Payback in allen europäischen Märkten

  • Du führst die Verantwortlichen für Performance Marketing, SEO, CRM und Partnerschaften, setzt ihre Ziele und gibst ihnen das Budget, um zu gewinnen

  • Du steuerst ein konsequentes Testing-Programm für Website, Checkout, Angebote und Onboarding

  • Du planst Markteintritte und Lokalisierung in neuen EU-Ländern gemeinsam mit Content, Kundenservice und Operations

  • Du baust Forecasts und Reportings, mit denen die Geschäftsleitung entscheidet, wohin der nächste Euro fließt

  • Du machst Parfum-Abfüllungen von 10ML zum selbstverständlichen Weg, einen Duft vor dem Flakonkauf zu testen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 8 Jahre in Growth oder Performance Marketing im D2C-E-Commerce, bei Marktplätzen oder Konsumgütermarken, davon mindestens 3 Jahre mit Führungsverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim profitablen Skalieren bezahlter und organischer Kanäle in mehreren europäischen Ländern

  • Sicher im Umgang mit Unit Economics: CAC, LTV, Deckungsbeitrag, Kohortenbindung

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads und Analysen auf SQL-Niveau

  • Fließendes Englisch; Deutsch oder eine weitere EU-Sprache ist ein großes Plus

  • Bonus: Erfahrung in Beauty, Duft, Kosmetik oder Luxus-Retail

title: Senior Sales Manager UK
description:
Our project for you:

moebel.de is Europe's leading price comparison site for furniture and home furnishings. Our family of portals operates in nine European countries, including Germany, France, Spain, the Netherlands, Italy and Poland.

Now we are getting started in earnest in the UK: living24.uk is live – our price comparison site for furniture, home furnishings, garden and décor, as well as white goods and home electronics. The launch is done, the technology works. What decides the pace now are the retailers: the more relevant shops list their ranges on living24.uk, the stronger the comparison for users – and the faster the portal grows.

This is not selling from a tidy list of existing accounts. You take on a freshly launched market and build the partner portfolio that living24.uk runs on. Whoever delivers over the next few months will shape what moebel.de looks like in the UK.

That is why we are looking for you as Senior Sales Manager UK.


Your future Tasks

  • Building the market: you build living24.uk's partner portfolio – from first contact through pitch and negotiation to the signed contract. Your targets are UK online retailers in furniture, home furnishings, garden, décor, white goods, home electronics and small appliances.
  • Selling a performance model: you show retailers how living24.uk pays off as an additional channel – through cost per click, visibility, feed quality and cost-of-sale.
  • Seeing partners through to go-live: product feed, tracking, range checks – together with the team in Hamburg. After go-live our Relationship Management team takes over day-to-day care, so you can focus on winning new partners.

title: Senior Sales Manager Polen (m/w/d)
description:
Unser Projekt für dich:

moebel.de ist Europas führender Preisvergleich für Möbel und Einrichtung. Mit unserer Portalfamilie sind wir in neun europäischen Ländern aktiv, darunter Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, die Niederlande und Italien.
Jetzt legen wir in Polen richtig los: mobi24.pl ist live – unser Preisvergleich für Möbel, Einrichtung, Garten und Dekoration sowie Weiße Ware und Haushaltselektronik. Der Launch ist geschafft, die Technik läuft. Über das Tempo entscheiden jetzt die Händler: Je mehr relevante Shops mit ihren Sortimenten auf mobi24.pl vertreten sind, desto stärker der Vergleich für die Nutzer und desto schneller wächst das Portal.
Das ist kein Vertrieb aus einer gepflegten Bestandsliste. Du übernimmst einen frisch gestarteten Markt und baust das Partnerportfolio auf, das mobi24.pl trägt. Wer hier in den nächsten Monaten liefert, prägt, wie moebel.de in Polen aussieht.
Dafür suchen wir dich als Senior Sales Manager Polen (m/w/d).


Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

  • Marktaufbau: Du baust das Partnerportfolio von mobi24.pl auf – vom Erstkontakt über Pitch und Verhandlung bis zum Vertrag. Zielgruppe sind polnische Online-Händler aus Möbel, Einrichtung, Garten, Dekoration, Weiße Ware, Haushaltselektronik und Elektrokleingeräte.
  • Performance-Modell verkaufen: Du erklärst Händlern, wie sich mobi24.pl als zusätzlicher Kanal rechnet – über Klickpreise, Sichtbarkeit, Feed-Qualität und Kosten-Umsatz-Relation.
  • Bis zum Livegang begleiten: Produktdatenfeed, Tracking, Sortimentsprüfung – gemeinsam mit dem Team in Hamburg. Danach übernimmt unser Relationship Management die laufende Betreuung, du konzentrierst dich auf neue Partner.
  • Präsenz im Markt: Händlerbesuche, Messen und Branchenevents innerhalb Polens. In einem jungen Markt entsteht Vertrauen im persönlichen Gespräch.

What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and the energy transition. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and help us accelerate our operations in the DACH region to the next level! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution.

The role is based in our beautiful office in Cologne, where your over 50 future colleagues cannot wait to meet you!

Your role

Germany is entering a major growth phase, with the network expected to expand significantly in the coming years. You will help design an operating model that can absorb this growth while keeping uptime above 99%, improving customer experience and managing costs and team growth responsibly.

title: Business Development Manager - 100%
description:
Tethys Robotics develops innovative robotic solutions for subsea inspection & investigation operations in challenging conditions. We serve clients such as governmental organizations, large asset operators and industrial service providers operating in high-demand and mission-critical environments.

As an ETH Zürich spin-off, we are a fast-growing pioneer in underwater robotics, rooted in Switzerland. Backed by strong funding and entering an exciting phase of international growth, we are looking for a driven and entrepreneurial person to help scale Tethys Robotics.

Tasks

This is not just about selling robots. You will take on a three-in-one role across sales, business development, and key account management, understanding customer problems, building long-term trust, running demonstrations in the field, closing complex deals, and bringing operational feedback back into the product.

Working side by side with our founders, engineers, and partners, you will help bring our underwater robots into real-world operations across defense, maritime security and offshore energy. Expect a hands-on role with international travel, live demos, trade shows, and customer visits in challenging operational environments.

We are looking for someone with high ownership, strong people skills, curiosity for robotics, and the ambition to help build something that has not really been done before. If you are excited by cutting-edge technology, enjoy working with people, and want to grow fast in a startup environment, we would love to hear from you.

Your Contribution

  • Own the full sales cycle in our priority markets: from prospecting and active outreach to closing deals.
  • Lead contract negotiations and take responsibility for bringing deals across the finish line.
  • Represent our technology where it counts: customer visits, online meetings, international trade shows, and live demonstrations in the field.
